之后的几天，王建新骑上自行车，有时候带上妹妹出去逛一逛。小妹丽丽最高兴了，坐在自行车后座上，两只手搂着三哥的腰，一路上叽叽喳喳地说个不停。

他们去过颐和园。昆明湖的水绿莹莹的，万寿山上的佛香阁在阳光下闪着金光。长廊里的人不多，三三两两的游客，走走停停。丽丽在长廊里跑来跑去，数柱子上的彩画，数着数着就数乱了，又从头数。

去过北海公园。白塔倒映在水中，小船在湖面上飘着，有人在唱歌，唱的是《让我们荡起双桨》。王建新租了一条船，带着妹妹在湖上划了一圈。丽丽把手伸进水里，撩起水花，笑得咯咯的。

也去了天坛公园。祈年殿的蓝色琉璃瓦在阳光下很漂亮，回音壁前人不多，丽丽站在一头喊“三哥”，王建新在另一头听得清清楚楚。

还去了香山公园，只是可惜叶子还没红。满山的绿，郁郁葱葱的，少了些意思。但丽丽不在乎，爬山爬得满头大汗，也不喊累。

去了景山公园，登上万春亭，可俯览整个京城。故宫的黄色琉璃瓦一片连着一片，灰砖灰瓦的四合院密密麻麻，远处的西山朦朦胧胧的。丽丽趴在栏杆上，指着下面说：“三哥，那是咱们家吗？”王建新看了看方向，说：“差不多，在那边。”

王建新自己还去了八达岭长城。长城这时已对游人开放，但游客稀少，更显古朴沧桑。他一个人爬上去，站在烽火台上，看着长城像一条巨龙蜿蜒在群山之间。风很大，吹得军装猎猎作响。他想起草原上的那道铁丝网，也是弯弯曲曲地延伸到天边。一个是人造的防线，一个是古老的城墙，都是用来抵御外敌的。他站了好一会儿，才下来。

幸福温馨的日子过得很快。每天早上醒来，能听见母亲在厨房里做饭的声音，能闻见小米粥的香味，能听见妞妞在隔壁屋里咿咿呀呀地说话。小妹丽丽缠着他讲故事，他就讲草原上的事，讲黄羊、讲狼、讲骑马。丽丽听得入了迷，说长大了也要去草原。

时间一晃便来到了八月三十一号。

这天早上，王建新穿好军装，四个兜的干部服，洗得干干净净，领章缀得端端正正。把该带的东西全部打好包——一个背包，一个帆布包，一个网兜装着洗漱用品。母亲站在门口看着他，眼眶红红的，但没哭。

“妈，我走了。”王建新背好行李，拎起东西。

“到了学校好好学习，别惦记家里。”母亲帮他整了整衣领，又拍了拍他肩膀上的灰。

“知道了，妈。”

父亲去上班了，大哥出车了，二哥也去厂里了。大嫂抱着妞妞送他到院门口，妞妞朝他挥手：“叔——叔——拜拜——”小妹丽丽拉着他的衣角，说：“三哥，你什么时候回来？”

“有空就回来就回来，你你也马上开学了，去了学校好好学习。”

“嗯。”丽丽点了点头，眼泪在眼眶里转，但没掉下来。

王建新出了胡同，坐上了公交车。学校在海淀区学院路三十八号，离得不近，公交车晃晃悠悠地开了快一个小时。

到了学校，王建新先找报到的地方。校园不小，绿树成荫，几栋红砖楼一字排开，看着挺气派。他找到了院系迎新站——几张桌子摆在教学楼门口，上面铺着白布，几个军管会干事坐在那里。

王建新走过去，把录取通知书递过去。一个女干事接过去看了看，又抬头看了看他——穿着军装，背着行李，腰板挺直。

“王建新同学，请出示团介绍信。”女同学说。

王建新从口袋里拿出介绍信，递给她。她核对了一下，在本子上登记了，然后喊了一个军管会的干事过来。带着王建新来到院系办公室，完成了身份核对，领取了学生证明。

“你的宿舍在四号楼二零六，六人间。这是钥匙。”干事把钥匙递给他。

王建新接过钥匙，问了一句：“宿舍都是几个人？”

干事说：“六人间和十人间，你这边特殊安排，六人间。”

王建新点了点头，没再问。也许因为他是军官，也许因为他立过一等功。不管怎样，六人间比十人间强多了。

他拎着行李找到四号楼。楼不新，灰砖墙，木门窗，楼道里有一股消毒水的味道。上了二楼，找到二零六房间，推门进去。

宿舍不大，二十来平米。三张上下两层的铁架床靠墙放着，中间一张长条桌，六个板凳围在桌子四周。墙上刷着白灰，有些地方掉了皮，窗户是老式的木窗，玻璃擦得还算干净。

靠窗户的下铺空着，其他五个铺位都已经铺好了被褥。王建新走过去，把自己的行李放在那张床上。

他先把床铺好。从背包里拿出褥子铺平，床单绷紧，四个角塞进褥子底下。被子叠成豆腐块，放在床头，帽子扣在被子上，武装带挂在床头的铁架上。动作干净利落，不到五分钟就弄完了。

然后他把洗漱用品从网兜里拿出来，他把牙缸、牙刷摆好，毛巾搭在盆沿上，放在床下。

其他五个人的东西也都摆着，牙缸排成一排。

In the next few days, Wang Jianxin rode his bicycle and sometimes took his sister out for a walk.The younger sister, Lili, was the happiest. She sat on the back seat of the bicycle, holding her third brother's waist with both hands, and kept chattering along the way.

They have been to the Summer Palace.The water of Kunming Lake is green and translucent, and the Buddhist Incense Pavilion on Wanshou Mountain shines golden in the sun.There were not many people in the corridor, just tourists in twos and threes, walking and stopping.Lili ran around in the corridor, counting the paintings on the pillars. She got confused and started counting again.

Been to Beihai Park.The white tower was reflected in the water, the boat was floating on the lake, and someone was singing "Let's Swing the Oars".Wang Jianxin rented a boat and took his sister for a row on the lake.Lili put her hand into the water, stirred up the water, and giggled.

We also went to Temple of Heaven Park.The blue glazed tiles of the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests are beautiful in the sunshine. There are not many people in front of the Echo Wall. Lili stands at one end and calls "Third Brother", and Wang Jianxin can hear clearly from the other end.

We also went to Xiangshan Park, but unfortunately the leaves were not red yet.The mountains are full of green, lush and a little less interesting.But Lili didn't care. She was sweating profusely while climbing the mountain, but she didn't complain about being tired.

After going to Jingshan Park and climbing to the Wanchun Pavilion, you can overlook the entire capital.The yellow glazed tiles of the Forbidden City are connected one after another, the courtyards with gray bricks and gray tiles are densely packed, and the Western Mountains in the distance are hazy.Lili lay on the railing, pointed down and said, "Third brother, is that our home?" Wang Jianxin looked in the direction and said, "It's about the same, over there."

Wang Jianxin himself also visited the Badaling Great Wall.The Great Wall was open to tourists at this time, but there were few tourists, which made it even more primitive and ancient.He climbed up alone and stood on the beacon tower, watching the Great Wall winding between the mountains like a giant dragon.The wind was strong, making the military uniforms rustle.He thought of the barbed wire fence on the grassland, which also stretched to the horizon.One is a man-made defense line and the other is an ancient city wall, both used to resist foreign enemies.He stood for a while before coming down.

The happy and warm days passed quickly.Every morning when I wake up, I can hear my mother cooking in the kitchen, smell the fragrance of millet porridge, and hear Niuniu babbling in the next room.The younger sister Lili pestered him to tell stories, and he told about things on the grassland, about gazelles, wolves, and horseback riding.Lili was fascinated and said that she would go to the grassland when she grew up.

Time flies and comes to August 31st.

This morning, Wang Jianxin put on his military uniform. The four-pocket cadre uniform was washed clean and the collar badges were neatly decorated.Pack everything you need to bring - a backpack, a canvas bag, and a mesh bag for toiletries.His mother stood at the door and looked at him, her eyes red, but she didn't cry.

"Mom, I'm leaving." Wang Jianxin packed his luggage and picked up his things.

"Study hard when you get to school and don't worry about home." His mother adjusted his collar and patted the dust on his shoulders.

"I got it, Mom."

The father went to work, the eldest brother got out of the car, and the second brother also went to the factory.The elder sister-in-law held Niu Niu and escorted him to the gate of the courtyard. Niu Niu waved to him: "Uncle - uncle - bye -" Little sister Lili pulled the corner of his clothes and said, "Third brother, when will you come back?"

"Come back when you have time. You will start school soon. Go to school and study hard."

"Yes." Lili nodded, tears welling up in her eyes but not falling.

Wang Jianxin left the alley and got on the bus.The school was at No. 38 Xueyuan Road, Haidian District. It was not close, and the bus drove slowly for almost an hour.

When he arrived at school, Wang Jianxin first looked for the registration place.The campus is not small, with green trees and several red brick buildings lined up, which looks quite impressive.He found the department orientation station - several tables were placed at the entrance of the teaching building, covered with white cloth, and several officers from the Military Control Commission were sitting there.

Wang Jianxin walked over and handed over the admission notice.A female officer took it and looked at it, then looked up at him - wearing a military uniform, carrying luggage, with a straight back.

"Classmate Wang Jianxin, please show me your letter of introduction to the group." said the female classmate.

Wang Jianxin took out the letter of introduction from his pocket and handed it to her.She checked it, registered it in the book, and then called an officer from the Military Control Commission to come over.I took Wang Jianxin to the department office, completed the identity check, and received my student certificate.

"Your dormitory is in Room 206, Building 4, room six. Here is the key." The clerk handed him the key.

Wang Jianxin took the key and asked, "How many people are there in the dormitory?"

The clerk said: "Six-person rooms and ten-person rooms, you have special arrangements here, six-person rooms."

Wang Jianxin nodded and didn't ask any more questions.Maybe because he is an officer, maybe because he has performed first-class merit.In any case, a six-person room is much better than a ten-person room.

He carried his luggage and found Building 4.The building is not new, with gray brick walls, wooden doors and windows, and the corridor smells of disinfectant.Go up to the second floor, find room 206, open the door and go in.

The dormitory is not big, about twenty square meters.Three two-tiered iron frame beds were placed against the wall, with a long table in the middle and six benches surrounding the table.The walls are painted with white dust, and the skin is peeling off in some places. The windows are old-fashioned wooden windows, and the glass is relatively clean.

The lower bunk by the window was empty, and the other five bunks were all covered with bedding.Wang Jianxin walked over and put his luggage on the bed.

He made the bed first.He took out the mattress from his backpack and spread it out. The sheets were tightened and the four corners were tucked under the mattress.The quilt was folded into tofu blocks and placed at the head of the bed. The hat was buckled on the quilt, and the armed belt was hung on the iron frame at the head of the bed.The action was clean and neat, and it was done in less than five minutes.

Then he took the toiletries out of the mesh bag, arranged the toothbrush and toothbrush, put the towel on the edge of the basin, and placed them under the bed.

The other five people's things were also laid out, and their toothbrushes were lined up in a row.
